args.command: shopt -s globstar nullglob; store_files=(store/**/*.go); other_files=(cmd/**/*.go internal/**/*.go server/**/*.go proto/**/*.go); NSTORE=${#store_files[@]} perl -e '@store=@ARGV[0..$ENV{NSTORE}-1]; @other=@ARGV[$ENV{NSTORE}..$#ARGV]; for $p (@store) { open F,"<",$p; local $/; $s=<F>; close F; while($s =~ /^type\s+([A-Z]\w*)\s+(?:struct|interface)\b/mg) { $types{$1}=1 } } for $t (keys %types) { %pkgs=(); for $p (@other) { open F,"<",$p; local $/; $s=<F>; close F; if ($s =~ /\bstore\.\Q$t\E\b/) { $p =~ m{^(.*)/[^/]+$}; $pkgs{$1}=1 } } push @out, [scalar(keys %pkgs),$t,join(",",sort keys %pkgs)] } $i=0; for (sort {$b->[0]<=>$a->[0]} @out) { last if $i++==20; print "$$_[0] $$_[1] $$_[2]\n" }' "${store_files[@]}" "${other_files[@]}"
